from sort import sort_list
from collections import Counter
cases = [[3,1,2], [], [5], [2,2,1], [3,-1,2,-1,0], [1,2,3]]
for c in cases:
    out = sort_list(c)
    assert all(out[i] <= out[i+1] for i in range(len(out)-1)), c
    assert Counter(out) == Counter(c), c
    assert len(out) == len(c), c
print('all witness properties verified: sortedness + permutation + length')
